library\(openxlsx\)

lookup_path <- "data/lookup/bmf_code_lookup.xlsx"

# Get all Z codes from ntee_code
ntee_code <- read.xlsx\(xlsxFile = lookup_path, sheet = "ntee_code"\)
z_codes <- ntee_code[grepl\("^Z", ntee_code$ntee_code\), ]

cat\("=== All Z-prefixed NTEE codes ===\\n"\)
print\(z_codes\)

# Get the Z mapping in ntee_code_major_group
ntee_major <- read.xlsx\(xlsxFile = lookup_path, sheet = "ntee_code_major_group"\)
z_major <- ntee_major[ntee_major$ntee_code_first_character == "Z", ]

cat\("\\n=== Z mapping in ntee_code_major_group ===\\n"\)
print\(z_major\)
EOF)
